positions.name: RehearsalMandateAsDecisionRecord
positions.frame: How does the mandate's aphoristic urgency about rehearsal relate to the flat cadence-and-owner record that formalizes it?
positions.why: src-1 issues the directive itself, sealed with an aphorism equating an unrehearsed rollback with no rollback at all — activated, authority-asserting, principle-level. src-2 and src-3 restate the same decision as flat structured fields (Cadence, Owner) in calm, matter-of-fact register, ratifying rather than arguing. The group holds a genuine tension worth reading together: the same operational commitment appears once as urgent doctrine and once as settled bureaucratic record, and neither register cancels the other.
